name: Amin Baahmed
bio: Amin Baahmed is a German actor, dancer, model, and journalist. He was born in Ottersberg in 1998 and grew up in Bremen. His film career already includes notable projects, including the feature film "Kundschafter des Friedens 2" (director: Robert Thalheim), the title role in the short film "Petja" (2021), and the lead role in the music video "Slow" (2024). In 2025, Amin Baahmed took on his first leading role in the Amazon Prime Video production “Drive – The Pretenders,” directed by Sergej Moya. The film is inspired by the Wattpad novel written by Tamara Lush.

credits.title: Drive - The Pretenders
credits.overview: A young mechanic fakes an engagement with racing's most scandalous star — officially for his reputation, secretly for her own shot behind the wheel. But soon the lie threatens to destroy everything — including what's already become so much more than just a deal.

credits.title: Kundschafter des Friedens 2
credits.overview: The retired GDR spies have just buried their old mentor in Cuba as they set out to save the last real bastion of socialism. But they didn't expect their biggest opponent so far: full board and Cuba Libre.
